## Research question

How can evidence from different European climate archives improve our understanding of the Younger Dryas?

## About the project

I am a co-initiator of the Younger Dryas Working Group, which brings together researchers working on lake records, speleothems, glaciers, chironomids, lipid biomarkers, and climate modelling to synthesize European evidence for this abrupt climate event.

## Approach

Scientific exchange and synthesis across lake records, speleothems, glaciers, chironomids, lipid biomarkers, and climate modelling.
